children: Russia's Gazprom said its gas output reached 216.55 billion cubic meters in the first half of 2026, up 3.4% year-on-year.
Gas supplies to China via the Power of Siberia pipeline in the first six months exceeded the same period of last year,  Gazprom said in its financial report on Friday.
Pipeline gas supplies to neighbouring countries rose by 29%, mainly due to supplies to Kazakhstan.
